name: Greek Chicken Tomato-Feta Skillet

fit.note: 491 cal is inside 400-650; 16g carbs is well under the 35g ceiling; no seafood; weigh-and-divide skillet scales cleanly to 14 servings. FIT.

dupe_evidence: Not a duplicate. Every Greek chicken dish in the digest is a rice-bowl or slow-cooker format (Chicken Souvlaki Rice Bowls, Slow Cooker Chicken Gyro Bowls, Slow Cooker Greek Chicken Bowls, Slow Cooker Mediterranean Chicken Bowls); this is a starch-free seared-breast pan sauce (cherry tomato + Kalamata + feta), a different plate on method and carb profile. Nearest accepted-slug neighbor, creamy-tuscan-chicken-skillet, is a Tuscan cream sauce, not a Greek tomato/olive/feta one.
cross_protein_collisions: Structurally a 'Greek tomato-Kalamata-feta skillet' that transfers directly to another protein. Watch for a Greek pork or Greek turkey tomato-feta skillet in those selectors' pools (protein-swap twin). The catalog's Greek Turkey Spanakorizo Skillet and Greek Pork Souvlaki are rice-based and do NOT collide, but a pooled starch-free turkey/pork Greek skillet would be the same dinner.
unmapped_flag: Greek seasoning blend has no board home - useful pricer-lane exercise, not a penalty per v2.1 5.1.
